_doc: Fleet addressing (tickets #1100 and #1104; #1104 supersedes the public-host part of #1100). Private address {container}.app (mesh only, no auth). Public address: c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/{container} (cookie or bearer) and the c3-pub allowlist; no per-app public subdomain, no api.* or mcp.* host. Explicit unauthenticated hosts: unprotected_hosts. Guard: _shared/test-fleet-addressing.mjs. transitional lists known violations while the #1104 stages migrate them; an entry that stops violating must be removed, and every list must be empty when #1104 closes.

unprotected_hosts.linktree.diegonmarcos.com: HTML only: GitHub Pages link page (serves /gh, /qrcode and static assets); owner ruling 2026-10-22: explicit public host
unprotected_hosts.auth.diegonmarcos.com: HTML+API: Authelia login portal and OIDC endpoints, must be reachable before any session exists
unprotected_hosts.c3-pub-api.diegonmarcos.com: API pub: analytics beacons, JMAP discovery, health
unprotected_hosts.vpn.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: WireGuard ws-tunnel and mesh bootstrap; peers hold no bearer before the tunnel exists
unprotected_hosts.analytics.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: public-site analytics beacons (matomo, umami, openobserve); to fold into c3-pub-api
unprotected_hosts.matrix.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: Matrix federation and client .well-known; matrix is federated
unprotected_hosts.jmap.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: JMAP session discovery (.well-known/jmap); Stalwart enforces Basic auth itself
unprotected_hosts.c3-pub.diegonmarcos.com: API pub: Cloudflare-proxied explicit allowlist (tiers.pub.allowlist), everything else 404
unprotected_hosts.nexus.diegonmarcos.com: HTML only: GitHub Pages static site, public on github.io anyway
unprotected_hosts.suite.diegonmarcos.com: HTML only: GitHub Pages static site, public on github.io anyway
unprotected_hosts.maps.diegonmarcos.com: HTML only: GitHub Pages static site, public on github.io anyway

mesh._doc: #1123: mesh names must live where no stranger can own them. Private namespace: <container>.mesh.diegonmarcos.com, served ONLY by fleet DNS (Hickory 10.0.0.1); the public zone carries no record under mesh. `.app` is a real public TLD (vaultwarden.app is someone else's live Vaultwarden) and is kept as an alias only until public_tld_alias_until (30 days from the stage (a) rollout), then test-fleet-addressing.mjs fails on every remaining .app name.

tiers._doc: Routing tiers (ticket #1104). pub: Cloudflare proxied (orange), unauthenticated, explicit allowlist only. pvt: DNS-only (grey), path per container, Authelia session cookie (web) OR fleet bearer (API/MCP clients) through the shared edge_auth gate. mesh: {container}.app, WireGuard is the trust boundary. Guard: _shared/test-fleet-addressing.mjs reads infra-sec_caddy/dist/configs/Caddyfile.

pub._portals_doc: The Authelia portal keeps its own host (cookie domain, OIDC issuer); /auth and /account on c3-pub redirect to it until the IdP can run under a sub-path.

mesh._doc: Architect ruling (#1104): the canonical mesh address is http://{container}.app:{port}, served directly by the container on its VM's WireGuard address (plain HTTP inside WG, no hub hop, no auth). Hickory owns a direct row per container (infra-net_hickory-dns/build.json dns.records.app); the container binds its port on wg0 only. The hub https .app vhosts are legacy; nothing may depend on them. transitional.mesh_direct lists containers still without a direct row; it only shrinks.

public._doc: Owner ruling 2026-10-22: the apex, www and the GitHub Pages custom domains (linktree, nexus, suite, maps) are the ONLY unauthenticated public HTML hosts, each declared explicitly. There is no public wildcard route; the *.diegonmarcos.com catch-all site only redirects to the apex and reaches no upstream. The guard rejects any wildcard site that proxies, serves files or responds with content.

redirects._doc: Retired own hosts: each answers a 308 to its c3-pvt path (method and body preserved). Added per stage; the guard checks the rendered Caddyfile.
